# BCGov Crow - v0.11.4

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow adds conditional architecture and development guidance for reviewable
decisions affecting people, responsible handling of information throughout its
lifecycle, and continuity when a service operates across channels.

## Highlights

- Architecture and development workflows now consider how consequential
  automated decisions can be explained, challenged, reviewed, and corrected.
- Architecture documents can distinguish primary and derived information
  stores, processing locations, retention authority, and correction paths
  without assuming approvals that have not been established.
- Multi-channel service designs can account for shared case state, authorized
  resumption, and confirmation of lawfully reusable information.

## Changes

- New conditionally routed service-responsibilities guidance and corresponding
  prompts in the solution architecture and architecture review templates.

- Crow asset validation: Passed - 0 errors, 0 warnings.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.11.4 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.11.4.zip --global --target copilot
```
